reviews.text: I was having issues with sharp pains with my dog. Cindy and Carol worked with me and got me in same day got my dog taken care of. They were extremely nice and so is the Vet. She was very understanding and very kind and she answered any questions I had with zero hesitation. The staff is just so kind it’s really almost unbelievable. Amazing customer service and constant smiles. This is my permanent Vet now.

DO NOT GO TO DR BENAVIDES!
Dr. Menzie is great. She’s thorough, understanding and professional. She has never pushed rabies vaccines on my cats (they had horrible adverse reactions as kittens), and even was perfectly fine writing a RX for a brand of food she doesn’t even sell because it was the better option for my cat.

Benavides took one blurry picture of some inflammation in my cats mouth a week ago and told me it was cancer. She said “we’ll need to do a full dental and a biopsy to determine if it’s benign or malignant cancer. I know that’s not the news you want to hear.”when I asked how we know it’s cancer she said “it’s almost always cancer when it’s a mass like that in the mouth.” We decided to take him to a veterinary dentist to get a second opinion. The dentist took one look in his mouth and said “I see no cause for a cancer concern. Right off the bat what I see is an inflamed gland behind his teeth, and very obvious tooth resorption. That tooth will just need to come out and we’ll figure out what’s causing the gland to be swollen. All
It takes is to look at the other gland to see that it’s not a mass, it’s just something causing inflammation.”
Tooth resorption is one of the most common oral issues cats face and Benavides didn’t even notice that one of his teeth was almost completely resorbed. The fact that a veterinarian, who is supposed to have been through a ton of education, jumped immediately to a cancer diagnosis and didn’t even notice the actual, COMMON issues that my cat was having is concerning. It was irresponsible of her to make that assumption and to word it the way she did. Even the veterinary dentist agreed it was irresponsible and strange that they wouldn’t attempt an antibiotic to combat what looked like a possible infection. She didn’t even seem to know that glands exist back there. We spent days panicking over our baby possibly dying of cancer because a “veterinarian” saw hoof prints and assumed it was a zebra instead of a horse. All she did was tell me it’s cancer and sent us home with an estimate for dental and biopsy, and some Gabapentin “to keep him comfortable”.

We like Dr. Menzie, but even so, her prices have gone up significantly the last year or so, and their office automatically tacked on an OSHA charge for any waste disposal. They ended up taking that off in the end, but still odd. Have never been to a vet that charges an extra fee for that. If you don’t mind the higher price, Dr. Menzie is a really good vet and your pets will like her.

It was our 1st visit, and I am always leary of changing doctors for me or for Chester. We were greeted friendly but professionally and our information collected and digitally entered. Very efficient and accurate. The technicians and doctor were comforting to Chester and he was pampered but well examined. We discussed his hitory and a plan for his treatment was put together. My beloved boy Chico was showing signs of a urinary tract issues, and I was overwhelmed by the stress that a potential catastrophe this could be for my poor boy. Luckily Chicos case hasn't been necessarily intensive, but thats becaues of the preventive care and expertise of Cyprus Falls Animal Hospital!

Its been a week since Chicos initial visit now team is still reaching out and committed to ensuring my boy is healthy and recovering.

Chico is doing better becaues of the care and concern of the wonderful practitioners at Cyprus Falls Animal Hospital, and I cant thank them enough!

We had a wonderful experience during an especially hard time for us. Our beloved dog, Mya, had to be euthanized and our regular vet had to cancel on us last minute. I called Cypress Falls in a panick and they were so helpful and got us an appointment within the hour! I was nervous since we had never been there before and obviously wanted our dog to be in good hands during her final moments. I have to say they exceeded our expectations and I couldn't have picked a better office. Every single person there from the front desk, vet tech and dr were so kind and compassionate. You can tell they really care about their patients and made us and Mya feel very comfortable as we said our goodbyes. I highly recommend them to anyone needing a good vet and will be switching to their office for the rest of our fur babies. Thank you again Cypress Falls for everything!

I will be forever grateful for the love and care Dr. Menzie and all the staff provided for my fur baby Lucky. The staff was always welcoming and kind, Dr. Menzie was always attentive to our concerns for our senior dog. I would definitely recommend their services for your pet, their prices are reasonable, the doctors and staff are honest and caring. A heartfelt thank you to Cypress Falls Animal Hospital for all the love and care they provide for all pets ❤️
